This paragraph covers the requirements for the installation of 4 hydraulically 
operated water monitors.

These water monititors shall be used, together with a fixed foam system, for the 
protection of the tank farm area.

When a tank is on fire, the foam system will protect the tank itself, and the 
water monitors will provide an adequate water cooling of the closed fuel tank 
(s) or to give coverage to fire fighting personnel in salvage or emergency 
situation

The monitors and their corresponding equipment's shall be located inside the 
fuel tank diked area

Each water monitor is manually operable, from a remote hydraulic desk, and 
locally through the hand wheels suitably mounted on the monitor rotating joints

The oil distribution tubing between the hydraulic power pack and the monitor or 
oil motors, shall be mounted in a cable tray

The monitors are permanently connected to the pressurized water ring and have an 
individual capacity of 500 its/min (90 cum/h)

The monitor supply line is provided with an isolating valve, which is equipeped 
like most isolating valves with a device to indicate the passage of water

Each monitor is further equipped with its own individual control valve in order 
to regulate the water flow according to the operator judgement

The monitors can be operated manually or from a remote control station, they are 
capable of a vertical rotation of 150 o and a full horizontal rotation of 360 o

The spray nozzle can be adjusted, also from the remote station, from a straight 
stream to a wide fog pattern

Operators are advised to practice with the actual movements of the monitors in 
order to become familiar with the controls and to experiment the various 
possibilities of water throw and reach
